description: Decode a caller-supplied merchant PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and evaluate each accepts[] option against an explicit buyer policy (networks, pay_to, assets, max atomic amount). Does not fetch merchant URLs or settle the inspected purchase. Unpaid → PaymentRequired for this server's analysis fee; pay via _meta['x402/payment']. Pass policy as a JSON object string.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

payment_required_header.description: Inspected merchant PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value (base64 wire from HTTP 402).
payment_required_header.title: Payment Required Header

policy.description: Buyer policy JSON object as a string. Example: {"allowed_networks":["eip155:84532"],"max_amount_atomic":"10000000"}
policy.title: Policy

request_digest.description: Optional JSON string with canonical_url, http_method, body_sha256.
request_digest.title: Request Digest

name: x402.policy_check
title: Offline buyer payment-policy consistency check
